audience: retail and ecommerce teams that run store credit and gift cards on Rise.ai

useCases.title: Find a customer's store credit wallet
useCases.text: Find a wallet by the customer's email or customer reference. The result includes the gift card and contact information.

useCases.title: Review store credit transactions
useCases.text: Find the wallet first, then list its issued, redeemed, refunded and disabled store credit actions with amounts and dates.

useCases.title: Track gift card orders
useCases.text: Find gift card orders with their status and fulfilment details. Use the filter to list only the orders you need.

useCases.title: Look up a gift card and its balance
useCases.text: Find gift cards by code, recipient, status or balance. Open one by its id to read its balance, status and expiry.

useCases.title: Trace changes to a gift card balance
useCases.text: List the increases, decreases and redemptions on gift cards to see how a balance changed over time.
